title: Hilbert–Schmidt inequality for the pull-back on all index tuples: Σ_j (A^#γ)(e∘j)² ≤ (‖A‖²)^m·Σ_j γ(e'∘j)²
statement: Let N, N', m ∈ ℕ, let A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} be a continuous linear map (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') with operator norm ‖A‖, and let γ be an m-covector on ℝ^{N'} (Covector (Euclid N') m). Let e_a := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin N) ℝ a (a ∈ Fin N) and e'_b := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin N') ℝ b (b ∈ Fin N') be the standard orthonormal bases. Let A^#γ := γ.compContinuousLinearMap A, so (A^#γ)(w_0, …, w_{m−1}) = γ(Aw_0, …, Aw_{m−1}). Then Σ_{j : Fin m → Fin N} ((A^#γ)(e_{j(0)}, …, e_{j(m−1)}))² ≤ (‖A‖²)^m · Σ_{j : Fin m → Fin N'} (γ(e'_{j(0)}, …, e'_{j(m−1)}))². Both sums run over all index maps j, not only the increasing ones.
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' m : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (γ : Covector (Euclid N') m), ∑ j : Fin m → Fin N, ((γ.compContinuousLinearMap A) (fun i => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin N) ℝ (j i))) ^ 2 ≤ (‖A‖ ^ 2) ^ m * ∑ j : Fin m → Fin N', (γ (fun i => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin N') ℝ (j i))) ^ 2
